assumptions: SALI (Guha & Van Drie 2008) on the similarity and scale given.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which pairs of similar molecules differ most in activity (SALI)?

description: SALI activity cliffs (Guha & Van Drie 2008) in a list of small molecules with one activity each: every pair scored as the activity difference over one minus the Tanimoto similarity of RDKit path fingerprints, steepest first; identical fingerprints with different activities score Infinity. Indices are 0-based.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

activities.description: one number per structure, in the same order; a non-number leaves it out.

molecules.description: the structures: one SMILES or molfile per entry.

scale.description: how the activities are read. Values: pIc50Um (pIC50 from a µM IC50), asGiven (As given).

name: activity_cliffs

pairs.description: every pair, highest SALI first: i the more active, j, similarity, SALI

summary.description: the cliffs in words, generated from this run
